problem: Trend and counter readouts: resolve('sparkline') returns UNDEFINED (no hits), resolve('a big streak counter') returns UNDEFINED (closest component/meter @ 4.0 via the 'readout' alias). The build needed a mini trend and a large numeral and had to improvise both.
insufficiency: No pack entry describes mini trends or numeral statics. The display face is described only as 'display-only moments (page mastheads, big statics), used sparingly' (L-04) with 'display 44 at tracking -1' (L-05) - construction, label treatment and frequency limits are undefined, and the type-scale / typography entries in the pack are stubs with no values.
reuse_case: Streaks, totals, scores, week-over-week trends - any product with counters or trends needs a readout; this is a recurring class (the demo needed both forms in one screen) rather than one-off chrome.
composition_check: Not composable: token-set/type-scale and guideline/typography carry no usable values or usage rules in the pack; no entry composes a sparkline mark; the 'one display moment per screen' limit is a new usage rule. Smallest change: one readouts pattern covering both forms - not separate components per metric.

proposed.title: Data readouts (sparkline trend, stat counter)
proposed.source_evidence: decisions.json L-04 ('big statics' display moments) and L-05 (display 44, tracking -1); 00-evidence-inventory.md section 2 (data presentation purpose); guideline/motion (static updates)

body.sparkline: mini rectilinear columns in Chicago blue over the London ramp; no axes; static; sits at metadata scale
body.stat: display-face numeral (display 44, tracking -1) + sans-caps label; used sparingly - one display moment per screen; streak counts qualify
body.excluded: no rings or gauges, no motion, no emoji/sparkle
body.in_character: a single loud numeral against quiet apparatus - restraint, not dashboard chrome

tests: at most one display-face numeral per screen (spec check)
no radial geometry is used for trends or counters (geometry check)
